hub.notes: Beep until confirmed: optional repeat of the turn chirp every ~2s until the turn is taken (either/or with the chirp-length slider, now up to 20x). The hub repeats for its own player turn and relays the mode to nodes.

node.notes: Retuned tones: 523-1319Hz C-major spread — every button now lives in the piezo's loud band (the old two lowest were quiet). Plus beep-until-confirmed: the turn chirp repeats every ~2s until you press, when enabled in the app.
